messages:
From: John Carter <john.carter@acmeinsurance.com>

Cc: security@acmeinsurance.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: new processing partner details for pilot

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. We’re preparing our procurement & security intake for the upcoming pilot with Acme Insurance and need a compact view of any third-party processing partners Redwood will add to the telemetry/observability pipeline as part of the pilot. Specifically:

- a one-sheet roster of processors (names, country of operations, role e.g., metrics ingest, telemetry relay)
- minimal-scope dataflow diagram showing if any telemetry or logs transit outside the US
- whether any new vendors will be able to access tenant-level logs or PII

Given time constraints for our legal review, a short deliverable with attachments is preferred (spreadsheet + single-page diagram). Can you confirm whether Redwood will be onboarding a telemetry relay vendor for this pilot and share the above by EOD Thursday PST? Also flag any expected need for DocuSign/DPA amendments.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

John Carter
Security Program Manager
Acme Insurance
security@acmeinsurance.com

Attachment: none

Quick plan:
1) Neha — can you confirm whether the telemetry relay (EdgeRelay Inc.) is considered a new subprocessor for this tenant pilot and prepare the roster row (name, role, locations, SCC/KMS if applicable)
2) Kimberly — please produce a single-page dataflow PNG that highlights any cross-border hops and whether data is pseudonymized/encrypted in transit
3) Marissa — collect minimal SOC2/KMS excerpts we can attach (redwood_dpa_excerpt.pdf will be a short snippet) and confirm whether a DPA amendment is required for this addition

Target: assemble as attachments and send to John by EOD Thu PST (we have 4 business days). If we need a DocuSign route, Marissa, flag and I’ll route to legal.

Thanks — Priya

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: new processing partner details for pilot

Adding my findings — preliminary roster row and notes attached.

Summary:
- Vendor: EdgeRelay Inc. (edgerelay@thirdpartyvendor.com)
- Role: telemetry relay (aggregates traces + metrics; no persistent raw tenant logs retained longer than 24h)
- Primary ops: US (CA), with a secondary relay node in EU for redundancy (no EU data for this specific pilot but routing capability exists)
- Access: service account-level ingest only; no direct tenant console access; no PII in the streams we send (traces are truncated and identifiers are hashed)
- Legal/Controls: supports TLS1.3, per-tenant API keys, optional KMS integration (customer-managed available)

Attachments included: processor_roster_v1.xlsx

Neha
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Priya — thanks for the quick triage and Neha for the roster. A couple of follow-ups:

- Can you attach a single-page dataflow diagram that explicitly labels any cross-border hops? Even if the pilot keeps data US-only, we need to see the potential path to EU nodes for our reviewers.
- We will need either a SOC2 excerpt or a controls snapshot for EdgeRelay — if they rely on Redwood's attestation, note that in the packet.
- DocuSign: our legal team will likely ask for a short DPA addendum listing the subprocessor; if Redwood prefers to provide a unilateral subprocessor notice + evidence first, that works too. Please indicate which route you recommend.

If you can send attachments and a suggested route to finalize (DocuSign vs notice) by EOD Thursday PST, we can keep the pilot timeline intact.

Appreciate it,
John

John — attaching the requested packet for the pilot. Notes below; attachments are zipped into the Drive link.

What we’re adding: EdgeRelay Inc. (telemetry relay) — role limited to ingest + short-term buffering (max retention 24 hours). For this pilot, we will not enable EU routing; dataflow diagram shows the capability but arrows to EU nodes are greyed as inactive. Tenant-level PII: our pipeline truncates request ids and replaces user identifiers with hashed IDs prior to relay. EdgeRelay does not have tenant console or log-search access.

Controls & evidence: we attached a short excerpt from our DPA describing subprocessor handling, a one-page dataflow diagram (dataflow_diagram_v2.png), and the processor roster (processor_roster_v1.xlsx). EdgeRelay’s SOC2 snapshot is included where they rely on Redwood’s control (see redwood_dpa_excerpt.pdf). If Acme’s legal requires a DocuSign addendum, we recommend the DocuSign route for speed — I’ve attached a suggested addendum template and flagged the HubSpot record HS-12345 for reference.

Drive packet: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-Onboarding-2028
DocuSign (suggested addendum): https://app.docusign.com/Acme-RIDPA-2028

Next steps: please confirm whether the evidence is sufficient or if you need us to route a full EdgeRelay SOC2 report via secure link. If you prefer the unilateral subprocessor notice first and addendum later, we can proceed that way too — we recommend DocuSign to complete the DPA amendment before pilot go-live.

Thanks — Priya
